notes.title: Excoverse - DEMO IS NOW PLAYABLE!
notes.content:
The celestials took your daughter. To save her, you must become a monster—without betraying your people.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3039230/1fde714f68061ec288e7fd260592de8347d12d90/ss_1fde714f68061ec288e7fd260592de8347d12d90.jpg?t=1748871201

What to expect in the demo?
This demo gives you a hands-on look at the upcoming action RPG, Excoverse. Step into the shoes of the noble lord for the first hour of gameplay, featuring:


 Stealth and combat introduction — Learn the basics of silent takedowns and fast-paced hack-and-slash action.
  Explore the opening area — Traverse the shadowy forest region, uncover hidden secrets, and meet key NPCs.
  Story preview — Experience the prologue cutscenes that set the stage for your desperate quest.


https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3775290/bf10c79cbaacf991de30b52dfa43a6c52515c0d6/ss_bf10c79cbaacf991de30b52dfa43a6c52515c0d6.jpg?t=1748796330


When will the full release happen, and what new content will it bring?

The full release is planned for 2025. I will announce the exact release date one month before launch. 

Excoverse is a solo-developed passion project. The biggest feature you can expect in the full release is a living, dynamic world. You’ll experience meaningful interactions with NPCs, branching progress shaped by your choices, new skills, and deep character progression — all among the standout elements waiting for you.

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3039230/12a36d8957054dfdc51530c2d8e5f652d65731c6/ss_12a36d8957054dfdc51530c2d8e5f652d65731c6.jpg?t=1748871201

Will the demo always be available?

No — the demo will be playable only during special time windows, which I’ll announce before key events and sales.

So jump in now, play the demo, and leave a review to share your feedback! Your thoughts are truly valuable to me!
